descriptionHtml:
Approach · EFS Empty & Failure States · S26 Existing api specs: a session idle for 12 hours is refused and needs a new code (TFA-94513 AC 4)

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U10b A session expires at 12 h idle and then needs a new email code. (TFA-94513 AC 4; UAT OAT-01 step 3) — gate: blocked: TFA-94513 in progress

Test design technique: Boundary values (boundary) — Sit right on the edge of the rule (exactly on time / a minute late, empty, longest, most) and see on which side the behavior changes.

Given Tim's api specs on the local stack, using the sessions:_backdateForTests admin seam

When Run the three tests by title

Then A new session lasts 12 hours idle; a session idle for 12 hours is refused, so the next call needs a new email code; an open tab fetching Convex tokens does not keep the session alive, while real use does

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): The specs' own assertions. Gated: a failure reports as Blocked: TFA-94513 in progress. The UI side of a session end (sign-in prompt, dictation kept) is S05 and S16, ungated

Where it ran: local lane A (existing Playwright tests); test method API · API (Convex functions); lane planned in the matrix: existing tests (Tim's Playwright) (automated)

S26 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/EFS.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: local — main e02167f, local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane A.

Test method: API · API (Convex functions); secondary: TIME · Time / aging (clock moved) — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: matrix (lane A).

UAT item: EFS Empty & Failure States · Section: A5 · Cross-Cutting · Scenario: EFS/S26

Existing api specs: a session idle for 12 hours is refused and needs a new code (TFA-94513 AC 4)

Result: passed in matrix/EFS.results.json (lane A: the existing Playwright specs below, run on the local stack; agent-matrix.sh).

Existing specs:

  • api/session-security.spec.ts [api] — signing in names the session in the token, and the session lasts 12 hours idle — expected
  • api/session-security.spec.ts [api] — a session idle for 12 hours is refused — expected
  • api/session-security.spec.ts [api] — an open tab fetching Convex tokens does not keep the session alive; use does — expected

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Lane A (Tim's api spec e2e/api/session-security.spec.ts): fresh @roundai.test accounts and the sessions:_backdateForTests admin seam, both through the local admin key; dev has no admin key, and ending a session there would end the shared saved sign-in, so it runs on the local stack only (Quinn 20…. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
